_comment: check-loaded.mjs (t112): files whose t() calls run only on behalf of a part that loads the catalog itself. Each entry adds `catalogs` to what `file` may rely on; `reason` names who loads them. Keep this short: prefer loadCatalog() where the id is shown.

entries.reason: disclosureSentence() is rendered only by modules/assist/Disclosure.tsx, which loads assist
note create/pin toasts follow actions taken in modules/notes, which loads notes
the create-failed toast follows a create in modules/tasks, which loads tasks
error texts for Settings screens (load both) and LinkedMailboxFactor (loads settings); a policy request reference is only shown next to a settings-policy error
the unsaved-tab close dialog opens from closing a tab in SubTabStrip, which loads workspace-tabs
